record.original_question: Let W be a Weyl group and let [u,v] be a Bruhat interval in W. Is the rank generating function of [u,v] always log-concave?

evidence.quote: Let (W,S) be a Coxeter system. It is of interest, and difficult, to obtain properties of the rank generating function of Bruhat intervals [u,v], u,v in W.
Conjecture 2.11. Let W be a Weyl group, and u,v in W. Then [u,v] is rank log-concave.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(W,S)$ be a Coxeter system whose underlying group $W$ is a Weyl group (i.e., a finite crystallographic Coxeter group, or more generally a crystallographic Coxeter group). For $w \in W$, let $\ell(w)$ denote the length of $w$ with respect to the simple generators $S$, and let $\leq$ denote the Bruhat order on $W$. For $u, v \in W$ with $u \leq v$, the Bruhat interval is
$$[u,v] = \{w \in W : u \leq w \leq v\},$$
and its rank generating function is
$$F_{[u,v]}(q) = \sum_{w \in [u,v]} q^{\ell(w)-\ell(u)} = \sum_{i=0}^{\ell(v)-\ell(u)} a_i\, q^i,$$
where $a_i = \#\{w \in [u,v] : \ell(w) = \ell(u)+i\}$.

A finite sequence $(a_0, a_1, \dots, a_n)$ of nonnegative real numbers is called log-concave if $a_i^2 \geq a_{i-1} a_{i+1}$ for all $1 \leq i \leq n-1$.

Prove or disprove: for every Weyl group $W$ and every pair $u, v \in W$ with $u \leq v$, the coefficient sequence $(a_0, a_1, \dots, a_{\ell(v)-\ell(u)})$ of $F_{[u,v]}(q)$ is log-concave.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2023–2025) addresses log-concavity of rank generating functions of Bruhat intervals only in partial settings: for instance, asymptotic log-concavity of dominant lower Bruhat intervals in affine Weyl groups has been established via Brunn–Minkowski techniques, and related conjectures (Brenti's) are discussed as still unresolved. No source confirms a full proof for all Bruhat intervals in arbitrary Weyl groups, indicating the conjecture remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic Log-concavity of Dominant Lower Bruhat Intervals via Brunn–Minkowski Inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic log-concavity is proved for dominant lower Bruhat intervals in affine Weyl groups, supporting but not resolving general log-concavity.
status_evidence.claim: Only an asymptotic version is proved in a special case; the general conjecture is not settled.

status_evidence.title: The Lehmer complex of a Bruhat interval
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Brenti's conjecture on log-concavity of rank-generating functions of Bruhat intervals as an ongoing problem.
status_evidence.claim: Brenti's log-concavity conjecture for Bruhat intervals is referenced as an open problem.
